notes.title: Demo Update July 2025
notes.content: [p]We just dropped a fresh update for the [b]Hell Games[/b] demo. Here's what's new:[/p][p][/p][p]🔥 Reworked weapon mechanics – smoother, deadlier, more fun  [/p][p]🎯 Visual and graphic improvements – hell has never looked this good  [/p][p]ːwinter2019coolyulː New traps – because dodging fireballs wasn’t enough [/p][p]🌀 Improved level transitions – more fluid, more immersive  [/p][p]🧠 UI/UX overhaul – easier to navigate, better to play [/p][p]🌎 Additional stages - more room for fighting[/p][p][/p][p]Meanwhile, we're working hard behind the scenes to bring you the full version of [b]Hell Games[/b]. It's taking some time – but it’s coming. Thanks for your patience and support![/p][p]Your feedback means the world to us. Try out the new version and let us know what you think – or what you'd like to see next. More madness is coming![/p]

notes.title: Update February 2025
notes.content:
Fiery updates you can expect from the newest version of the Hell Games demo:

[list]
[*] New feature: destructible objects
[*] New map, designed by our intern Lukas
[*] Balancing changes
[*] Overhauled lighting
[*] New settings menu
[*] Choosable Player Colors
[*] Colorblind options
[*] Minor changes and fixes
[/list]

Happy Gaming!
